description:
Cinemas, theatres and concert halls, museums and art galleries: counts in the suburb, rates per 1,000 residents and distance from the suburb centre to the nearest of each.

Coverage: All Australian suburbs and localities. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/arts-and-entertainment`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: count_cinemas, per_1000_cinemas, nearest_km_cinemas, count_theatres, per_1000_theatres, nearest_km_theatres, count_museums, per_1000_museums, nearest_km_museums, count_total, per_1000_total, per_km2_total. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_amenities_arts_and_entertainment
title: Suburb · Arts, culture and entertainment
